name: hud_ui_flash_panel_set_flash_rate
description: HudUiFlashPanel::SetFlashRate initializes rate-only flash mode when not already in mode 1 and otherwise leaves the current flash state unchanged.
tier_s_evidence: python tools/recoil.py verify vc5 0x4bc980 passed with compiler profile vc5_o2_ob1_gx_facs, VC5SP3 cl 11.00.7022, flags /nologo /TP /W3 /G5 /O2 /Ob1 /GX /Zp4 /FAcs /I ., and zero unmasked byte mismatches after COFF relocation masking.
functional_evidence: Current Binary Ninja disassembly for 0x4bc980 returns immediately when flashMode is 1; otherwise it calls ResetFlashState(flashRate) and writes flashMode = 1.

Native smoke verifies SetFlashRate sets flashEnabled, half-rate reset/countdown, direction, and flashMode on first use, and that the mode-1 path leaves existing reset/countdown/direction fields unchanged.
